subject: BlueLine Logistics: outstanding items
body:
Hi Patricia,

I'm following up on several items we've requested and haven't yet received:

- Full Q1 2025 covenant package (first requested March 2025)
- Updated 12-month cash flow projection, with assumptions stated explicitly (first requested April 15, 2025)
- Documentation on the two new regional contracts: names, volumes, start dates and revenue estimates (first requested April 15, 2025)
- Current driver headcount compared with 90 days ago (first requested April 15, 2025)
- Next covenant compliance package (first requested June 2, 2025)

Could you reply with the date you'll send these? If something is holding them up, I'm happy to set up a short call this week to talk it through and agree on a timeline.

Thanks,
Sarah
